======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Appellant/s : Mr. Santosh Kumar, Advocate
 For the Respondent/s : Mr. Bal Mukund Prasad Sinha, App
 For the Informant : Mr. Mritunjay Kumar, Advocate
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Chandra Shekhar Jha
 Oral Order

Learned counsel appearing for the appellant after short argument submitted as not to press the prayer for bail and suspension of sentence of the appellant as raised through memo of appeal itself for the present.
2. Considering the aforesaid, the prayer for bail and suspension of sentence of the appellant is rejected herewith for the present.

3. However, considering the submission, as appellant was convicted for the offence under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code, where any appeal be decided within six months of its filing in view of Section 374(4) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, office is directed to list this matter Patna High Court CR.
APP (SJ) No.4174 of 2023(3) dt.12-11-2024 under the heading "For Hearing" on 19.11.2024

(Chandra Shekhar Jha, J.) Sanjeet/-
